title: Environment Record Metadata
description: CBOR metadata on the environment record (open + close). Informational and UNSIGNED: the signed payload names its own type and is described by environment-<type>.json. Readers must take the type from the payload, never from this metadata.

type.description: Echo of the payload's descriptor type (e.g. oci-image/v1, vm-disk-chain/v1). On the open record this is the literal "environment".

driver.description: vm-disk-chain/v1: the driver that booted the environment.

reference.description: oci-image/v1: image reference as specified by the user.

digest.description: oci-image/v1: registry digest of the pulled reference. Equals sha256(payload) only when the runtime returned the registry's exact manifest bytes.
